title: Clinical efficiency of adjunctive subgingival air-polishing with and without application of biologics in the non-surgical treatment of patients with periodontitis stage III/IV - a multicenter randomized clinical trial
summary:
The removal of bacterial deposits from the root surface by mechanical means is considered the most important measure in the treatment of inflammatory periodontal diseases. Both the optimization of this mechanical debridement and the use of locally applied regenerative agents may improve the therapy of these diseases. The aim of the study is to evaluate, in patients with severe periodontitis undergoing non-surgical therapy, the additional benefit of an air-polishing device and the application of regenerative biomaterials (hyaluronic acid and enamel matrix proteins) compared with conventional treatment.

For this purpose, patients with generalized severe periodontitis will be recruited who have at least one deep periodontal pocket in each quadrant of the oral cavity. In each quadrant, one of four different therapies will be performed, assigned at random. Therapy A consists of conventional root surface debridement within the periodontal pockets using ultrasonic and hand instruments. In Therapy B, in addition to Therapy A, the periodontal pockets will be treated with an air-polishing device using a low-abrasive (trehalose-based) powder. Therapy C consists of Therapy B plus the application of a hyaluronic acid gel into the cleaned periodontal pocket. In Therapy D, in addition to Therapy B, a gel containing enamel matrix proteins will be applied.

To investigate the clinical benefit of these interventions, pocket probing depths and inflammatory parameters will be measured before treatment, and again at 3 and 6 months afterwards. The changes in these values will then be compared between the therapy groups and statistically analyzed.

interventions.name: Scaling & Rootplaning (SRP) using ultrasconic scaler and Gracey curettes
SRP + subgingival trehalose powder air-polishing (TPAP) for 20 seconds per tooth
SRP + TPAP + application of a cross-linked hyaluronic acid gels (Hyadent BG, Regedent)
SRP + TPAP + applikation of enamel matrix derivatives (Emdogain FL,. Straumann)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Patients with generalized Stage III or IV periodontitis
• At least 18 remaining teeth
• At least one single-rooted tooth in each quadrant with at least one site showing a probing depth of ≥ 6 mm (“index tooth”)
• Radiographic evidence of periodontal bone loss exceeding 33% of the root length
Exclusion criteria:
• Subgingival root surface instrumentation within the last 12 months
• Use of local or systemic antibiotics within the last 4 month
• Intake of medications associated with the development of gingival overgrowth
• Intake of medications affecting bone metabolism (antiresorptives)
• Systemic diseases known to interact with periodontal diseases or requiring prophylactic antibiotic coverage
• General health risk due to an increased risk of bacteremia
• Pregnancy
